content.intro: This lesson covers Understanding the PowerShell Location in the PowerShell learning path. It expands the supplied syllabus heading into an actionable draft with a visual, a worked example, and a short knowledge check.
content.why_it_matters: Use command discovery and built-in help before composing a longer command. Inspect returned object types and properties, quote paths containing spaces, and keep destructive operations previewed or confined to disposable practice data. Formatting is for people; select and preserve structured properties before the final display step.

content_blocks.title: Version and safety note
content_blocks.text: The main path targets modern PowerShell 7.6 LTS. Windows PowerShell 5.1 compatibility is labeled separately. Some providers, admin cmdlets and APIs depend on OS, module version, permissions or tenant access; the examples are static references, not proof of execution.
